method: Relative terrain heuristic, not calibrated catch probability. Flat numerical noise is excluded. Unknown interpolation masks remain unknown. All outputs held until a current whole-polygon legal screen.
species_fit_method: 3: fully inside the cited planning band and terrain A/B; 2: overlaps the band (including terrain C); 1: outside. These bands are explicit planning proxies, not demonstrated local optima. No grade or fit with insufficient metric support.

lingcod.label: Lingcod
lingcod.evidence: ADF&G species profile: typical rocky reefs at 30–330 feet. Transfer of general West Coast habitat guidance to California; not locally calibrated.
lingcod.evidence_scope: General species profile from Alaska agency

rockfish-reef.label: Reef rockfish — copper habitat proxy
rockfish-reef.evidence: CDFG NFMP Appendix D, D-40–41: copper rockfish high-relief reef/rock-sand interfaces; Big Sur observations at 22–98 m. Observation band used as a planning proxy, not an optimum for all rockfish.
rockfish-reef.evidence_scope: Central California copper rockfish; other rockfish differ

gopher-rockfish.label: Gopher rockfish
gopher-rockfish.evidence: CDFG NFMP Appendix D, D-41: adult gopher rockfish commonly 9–37 m on reefs or kelp beds.

cabezon-shallow-reef.label: Cabezon reef habitat
cabezon-shallow-reef.evidence: CDFG NFMP Appendix D, D-3: hard-bottom habitat from intertidal to 102 m. Broad occurrence envelope only; no numeric preferred-depth band established.
cabezon-shallow-reef.evidence_scope: Broad occurrence; this score cannot rank shallow vs deep preference
